assignments.essential_function: Optional complete original productivity plugin for persistent tasks,memory,initialization and sync.
native_prerequisites: Original plugin layout,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and productivity command dispatch must be natively supplied.
Persistent working files and a browser supporting File System Access APIs for dashboard.
Connected data sources optional as authored; no rewriting paths,commands or instructions to simulate compatibility.
limitations: Current production AutoGPT support for these exact native prerequisites was not verified.
Kept outside main expert skills lists; do not present it as ready to install on AutoGPT.

assignments.essential_function: Reconcile tasks with available project systems and optionally scan email/chat/calendar for missed commitments, asking before additions.

review: The authored task/memory workflow is retained with bundled sibling guidance and a local dashboard asset. It requires shared persistent TASKS.md, CLAUDE.md and memory/ state, a browser with File System Access APIs, and native productivity command dispatch. Packaging does not register commands or verify runtime behavior. Original source-layout observations are retained separately as historical research.
native_prerequisites: Writable persistent TASKS.md,CLAUDE.md,memory folder; user can open dashboard in a browser supporting File System Access APIs.
Original optional connectors for tracker/chat/email/calendar/docs; normal provisioning only,no dispatch wrappers or instruction overrides.
A stable shared working directory for TASKS.md, CLAUDE.md and memory/ that all four workflows use across sessions.
Ability to deliver/open dashboard.html in a browser with File System Access APIs against those same persistent files.
Use bundled sibling documents as instructions; no /productivity:* command handler is installed by this recipe.
original_native_prerequisites: Complete unchanged productivity plugin source/layout including all4skill files,skills/dashboard.html,CONNECTORS.md and clean child LICENSE.
Runtime must supply original CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and productivity command dispatch; current AutoGPT support is not verified.
Writable persistent TASKS.md,CLAUDE.md,memory folder; user can open dashboard in a browser supporting File System Access APIs.
Original optional connectors for tracker/chat/email/calendar/docs; normal provisioning only,no dispatch wrappers or instruction overrides.

dependency_decisions: Only the referenced startup/task/update chain is bundled; memory-management is included only as its own primary skill because startup already contains its complete memory bootstrap. No plugin metadata, README, unrelated skills or test fixtures are bundled.
runtime_blockers: The dashboard/browser and agent must access the same persistent task/memory files. Source relocation cannot provide that filesystem/UI integration.

research_pin_note: The installed source pin remains explicit above; already clean licensed packages may retain their earlier reviewed pin rather than mix historical support files.
source_review_limitations: Original Claude/Cowork command dispatch, plugin-root path and local file semantics must be available; no replacement runtime is claimed.
Does not provide a full inbox-priority, travel or calendar-rescheduling service.
source_review_limitations_scope: Original-source research observations retained verbatim. Statements about unchanged instructions or upstream folder layout describe the reviewed originals; this package applies only the recorded metadata/name/path adaptations. Current packaging decisions and runtime requirements are recorded separately.
historical_research_prerequisites: Original productivity plugin layout, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, dashboard.html, TASKS.md, CLAUDE.md and memory/; compatible command dispatch and filesystem.
Original plugin directory and any CONNECTORS.md preserved; optional connected modes require the actual named service capabilities.
historical_source_review: Conditional unchanged native productivity refresh. Compares externally assigned tasks to TASKS.md,presents diffs,triages stale items,fills context gaps; comprehensive scan runs interactively and asks before adds. Requires authored persistent layout and start/task/memory sibling capabilities.4.8K installs.
